title: Pure World Chalice
summary: World Chalice cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. World Chalice turns its three Normal Monsters into a Link climb. Imduk the World Chalice Dragon is a Link-1 from any Normal and grants an extra World Chalice Normal Summon. Lee the World Chalice Fairy searches any World Chalice monster. World Legacy - "World Chalice", Normal Summoned and then tributed or used as material, summons two World Chalice monsters from the Deck. Every World Chalice Link summons a World Chalice from the hand when it leaves the field, so the climb keeps feeding itself up to Ningirsu the World Chalice Warrior. Ningirsu draws for each World Chalice it points to and sends a card from each field to the GY. Ib the World Chalice Justiciar, the newest card (2019), treats a World Chalice Normal as a Tuner and searches a World Legacy card. The page calls Justiciar Forbidden, but the current TCG list on the site doesn't.
